_source.notes: column_values is a flat {columnId: value} map (mapItem/getColumnValueData): status -> cv.text or null; board_relation -> linked_items[]; formula -> display_value; mirror -> 'Column value type is not supported'; MLS battery -> battery_value; everything else -> cv.text if truthy, else JSON.parse(cv.value), else value||null. So empty date/status come back null. No column type info is returned: call get_board_info to learn which column id is people/status/date. 'group' included by default (includeGroup=true). parent_item_id only appears for subitems. url is the GraphQL Item.url ('The item's link'). No items for a searchTerm -> plain text 'No items found matching the specified searchTerm'. Column ids here (person/status/date4) are typical defaults but board-specific.
_source.synthetic_values: IDs, names, dates are invented; key names, nesting and ordering follow the source.
